prompt: What architecture stacks could I build a new demo with?
why: AI-1q tier 1: coverage prompt, drafted from the tool description. A MISS here is a discoverability finding about the tool, not a bad prompt.
said: Working on the Demo Builder home — I'll pull the list of available stacks.

There are four stacks — two frontends, each paired with either Commerce backend:

| Stack | Frontend | Backend | Needs GitHub + DA.live |
|---|---|---|---|
| Headless + PaaS | Headless (CitiSignal-style) | Adobe Commerce PaaS | No |
| Headless + ACCS | Headless | Adobe Commerce Cloud Service | No |
| Edge Delivery + PaaS | EDS storefront | Adobe Commerce PaaS | Yes |
| Edge Delivery + ACCS | EDS storefront | Adobe Commerce Cloud Service | Yes |

The main choice is frontend: Edge Delivery gives you a DA.live-authored storefront (needs a GitHub repo and DA.live site), while Headless skips both and is quicker to stand up. Then pick PaaS or ACCS depending on which Commerce backend the demo should showcase.

Tell me the stack and a project name and I'll create it.

prompt: What environment variables does the EDS storefront component need, and what does each one mean?
why: AI-1q tier 1: coverage prompt, drafted from the tool description. A MISS here is a discoverability finding about the tool, not a bad prompt.
said: Working on bodea — I'll pull the EDS storefront component's requirements from the demo-builder tools.

The EDS storefront needs no required environment variables — it works out of the box. It has two optional ones:

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `MESH_ENDPOINT` | The Mesh Query URL. Filled in automatically after you deploy the API Mesh — you don't set it by hand. |
| `AEM_ASSETS_ENABLED` | When on, product images load from AEM Assets instead of the Commerce catalog. Turn it off if your Commerce backend doesn't have AEM Assets set up. |

It also has no required services or component dependencies, so nothing else needs to be configured just to run it.
